query:
SELECT
            id,
            password_hash,
            is_active,
            CASE WHEN locked_until > NOW()
                THEN CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (locked_until - NOW())))::BIGINT
            END AS "lock_remaining_seconds",
            (locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until <= NOW()) AS "lock_expired!"
        FROM users
        WHERE email = $1 AND role = 'admin'
